essence: Thus accomplished, one attains the status of a manu-minister and a great yogi-lord.
Pārvatī posed a question to Śaṃkara, the supreme lord.
Pārvatī requests Śaṃkara to tell her about Mañjughoṣa, who grants desired objects in the world.
The requested mantra grants devotees' desires like another wish-fulfilling tree.
By knowing this, even a dull-minded person becomes mostly equal to the lord of speech.
